records.name: BaseTab AI
records.tagline: Turn your new tab into an AI-powered workspace
records.description: BaseTab turns your browser's empty new tab into a dashboard you arrange yourself. Drag in 30+ widgets: notes, to-dos, Kanban, Pomodoro, bookmarks, weather, Google Calendar, Gmail, and chat with Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Missing a widget? Describe it in plain words and AI builds it for you. Keep separate workspaces for work and life, share one with your team, and pick a background that feels like home. Free forever, works without an account, and asks for site access only when a widget needs it.

records.name: WinnerAdSpy
records.tagline: Turn competitor ad insights into winning app campaigns
records.description: Winneradspy is an ad creative intelligence platform built specifically for mobile app and game marketers. Explore 20M+ ad creatives across 200K+ apps, uncover winning hooks, visuals, messaging and CTAs, and track competitor campaigns with real-time alerts. Unlike generic ad spy tools, it scores creatives as Winner, Loser or Learning, helping UA managers, growth teams and agencies understand what works and build better campaigns. Query ad insights through ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini via MCP.

records.name: AC Bridge
records.tagline: Your smart lights show when Claude Code or Codex needs you.
records.description: AC Bridge turns the smart lights and plugs you already own into ambient status for Claude Code and Codex. See at a glance whether your agent is working, blocked or done, and let Claude Code or Codex drive the devices you have connected, as a step in a task. Works with Hue, Govee, WLED, LIFX, Nanoleaf and more, plus Home Assistant.

records.name: Hemmed
records.tagline: Hide Mac menu bar clutter and pin individual actions
records.description: Native macOS app that hides menu bar icons behind one item, rescues icons stuck behind the notch, pins menu commands to hotkeys, keeps new menu bar apps hidden, flags battery-hungry hidden apps, and syncs your layout across your Macs with iCloud.

records.name: GitHub Copilot Fusion
records.tagline: GitHub's AI coding agent that picks and combines models
records.description: GitHub Copilot Fusion takes the guesswork out of choosing AI models for coding. Choose Standard, High, or Max effort to balance speed, quality, and cost. Available across GitHub Copilot plans in VS Code, Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and JetBrains IDEs.

records.name: Specsight
records.tagline: Product observability for teams shipping fast with AI
records.description: Shipping fast with AI? Specsight turns code changes into a living product map, feature knowledge, and clear release updates. Keep Product, Sales, and Support in sync with what your software actually does and what changed.

records.name: CubbyPad
records.tagline: Launchpad is back on macOS 26, and it's smarter
records.description: Apple removed Launchpad in macOS 26. CubbyPad brings back the full-screen app grid: pages, folders you arrange, F4, hot corners and the trackpad pinch. Then it goes further: a search bar that does maths, opens System Settings pages and runs your Shortcuts; Apple Intelligence that sorts your apps into folders on your Mac; and a row of the apps you use at this time of day. One-time purchase for 2 Macs, in 20 languages.

records.name: ChainPoints
records.tagline: Flight Prices in Your Points, on Google Flights
records.description: ChainPoints is a free Chrome extension that shows you the cheapest way to book flights with your credit card points, live on Google Flights fare.

records.name: Knucklebop
records.tagline: tap your palm rest to control your Mac
records.description: Tap twice to mute your mic in any meeting. Three times to play music. Four for a menu of anything.

records.name: Backenly
records.tagline: The autonomous backend for AI coding agents
records.description: Backenly is an autonomous backend platform built for coding agents. Your agent builds the backend over MCP, from Postgres to sign-in, storage, functions and realtime. Then it maintains itself: every minute a self-healing loop repairs missing indexes, RLS gaps and dead realtime triggers, verifying each fix live. As your app grows, it restructures its own schema once you approve. Risky changes wait for you, and every change is versioned with rollback.

records.name: Agnos
records.tagline: Clean documents for AI, and see what was removed
records.description: Agnos cleans PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and web pges before they go into an AI chatbot, a RAG knowlede base or training data. It removes repeated headersand footers, page numbers, cookie banners, boilerplae and duplicates, and keeps tables, code and numbers It names the rule behind every removal; keep a piec or switch its rule off. Exports JSONL chunks, cleand text or training data. Runs on your Windows PC; nohing is uploaded. From the Microsoft Store: 14 days ree, then $99 once.

records.name: AwaitIO
records.tagline: Write a TypeScript function, get an admin screen
records.description: Turn async TypeScript functions into internal tools. Every await io.input shows a form in the browser and waits for the answer. Build a secure, self-hosted back office in minutes with zero frontend code and zero telemetry. Free for up to 3 users.

records.name: Mo
records.tagline: A little character on your Mac who does 232 tasks for you
records.description: Mo lives on your Mac screen and does the work for you: files, PDFs, photos, email, calendar, settings, routines and more, 232 tasks with no other app. Talk or type, get answers as cards, undo anything. Private, local models or your key. $19.99 once.

records.name: SpaceO
records.tagline: Give AI agents their own screen on your Mac
records.description: Give AI agents a separate display for real Mac apps while you keep working. Connect through MCP or the CLI, watch sessions in the Viewer, and take over when an agent needs help. Supports native apps and Chromium. Free and MIT licensed; Apple Silicon, macOS 14+. Attention isolation, not a security sandbox: apps run as your macOS user. Runtime support depends on your macOS build.

records.name: telemetry.dev
records.tagline: LLM observability for AI agents
records.description: telemetry.dev shows each run of your AI agent as one trace. Each model call and tool call is a span with its duration, tokens, cost, and error. Prompts and evals use the same traces: change a prompt without a deploy, then run it on a dataset and compare the scores with production. Alerts tell you about errors, cost spikes, and agent loops. Connect with our TypeScript or Python SDK, or with the OpenTelemetry exporter that you already use.

records.name: Godwit
records.tagline: An open-source, AI-native email client
records.description: Godwit is an open-source desktop email client for any IMAP/SMTP account, with an AI assistant, Wit, that reads, summarizes, translates and drafts mail with the model you choose.

records.name: LumaFold: Screen Light
records.tagline: Makeup Mirror & Color Effects for iPhone Duo
records.description: Make your iPhone Duo screen a creative studio with adjustable screen lighting, a live makeup mirror, color animations, and personal photo displays. LumaFold lets you use two screen areas differently. Light your face while checking your makeup, pair two colors for a creative shot, or combine a favorite photo with a handwritten message. LIGHT FOR YOUR BEAUTY ROUTINE Use the live camera mirror on one side and adjustable light on the other.

records.name: Secret Key
records.tagline: Let your family unlock your passwords if you can't
records.description: Open-source, self-hosted emergency access for your password database. Split the master password into pieces for people you trust (e.g. any 3 of 5 unlock it). Access needs SMS verification and a 48-hour delay you can cancel with one click.

records.name: Pluto Door
records.tagline: SSH client with an AI agent and a desktop for every server
records.description: This launch adds Ori, an AI agent that reads your servers, finds what's wrong and explains it in plain English. When something needs to change, you see every command first and nothing runs until you approve; every edited file can be undone. Pluto XOS turns each server into a desktop with 15 apps, Hangar installs software in one click, and scheduled checks notify you before small problems grow. Works with AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Your servers and keys stay on your Mac. Free for 14 days.

records.name: Coding Wrapped
records.tagline: See how you really vibe code with Claude Code & Codex
records.description: Your agent remembers every session. You don't. Coding Wrapped turns your local Claude Code & Codex history into a pixel-art Wrapped: your rhythm, the words you repeat ("continue", anyone?), what the agent quietly took over, and one small tip for each habit. Open source, one command, 100% local.

records.name: Seqora
records.tagline: Design your schema on a canvas. Seqora writes the SQL.
records.description: A desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite. Change tables on an ER canvas and Seqora writes the SQL. Every index, constraint, trigger and function gets its own page with size, usage and health. Visual EXPLAIN shows the plan step by step with measured timings. macOS and Windows, no account.

records.tagline: Gets a Muse Charm at 75% off using budget TEMU hardware

records.name: Buildvia Statement Converter
records.tagline: Convert Bank Statement PDFs into Excel in Seconds
records.description: Tired of manually entering bank transactions into spreadsheets? Buildvia Statement Converter makes it easy to convert digital bank statement PDFs into structured Excel files. Key Features: • Extract transaction details from PDF bank statements • Convert statements into structured Excel spreadsheets • Reduce manual data entry • Save time on financial record management

records.name: Dameter
records.tagline: Don't move. Stare at your phone. Get graded by a sloth.
records.description: Your laziness finally has a number. Dameter reads your steps, distance, active calories and Screen Time, then grades your day out of 500: the less you move and the longer you stare at your phone, the higher you score. Ranks go from F all the way up to SSS, and SSS takes a truly heroic amount of doing nothing. Your grader is Namataro, a slightly lonely sloth who writes in his diary every day, whether you show up or not. It's a joke app, but he takes the job very seriously. Free on iPhone.

records.name: Post-Quantum Pretty Good Privacy PQ-PGP
records.tagline: Composite post-quantum cryptography in accordance RFC 9980
records.description: The mandatory combination of lattice-based algorithms (ML-KEM and ML-DSA) with classical elliptic curves guarantees total protection. The data remains protected both against tomorrow's quantum computers and against unknown mathematical weaknesses in the new algorithms.

Custom MEV bot solutions can be configured for different blockchain ecosystems with efficient processing, real-time monitoring, and adaptable execution logic.

records.name: Continuity Relay
records.tagline: Continue your AI projects without losing your progress
records.description: Long ChatGPT conversations can become difficult to continue when they reach their limits. Continuity Relay helps preserve the working state of your projects, including important decisions, instructions, constraints, progress, and unresolved tasks. It creates a portable XML file that you can bring into a new conversation to resume your work without having to reconstruct everything manually. Available directly inside ChatGPT, with a free trial.

records.name: Action Shooter
records.tagline: Android Mobile Game

Each wave challenges you to improve your score and shooting skills. 💥 Powerful Combat Take down different enemy types, avoid enemy attacks, and keep firing to survive.

records.tagline: Reduces mind clutter, and improves productivity

records.name: Doxudel
records.tagline: 100% offline document redaction and PII anonymizer
records.description: Doxudel is an offline-first Windows workstation for document redaction and PII de-identification. records.tagline: Learn any language, explained in the one you already speak

Talkite explains every lesson in the language you already speak, so a Malayalam speaker can learn German, Kannada or Japanese in Malayalam. 23 languages, any pair. Each day takes 10 minutes: new words with audio, a pronunciation check, a quiz that builds real sentences, and a live voice chat with Kite, an AI tutor that uses only the words you just learned. Exam speaking practice for Goethe, IELTS, OET and TEF. The 30 day course is free.

It validates syntax and shows clear errors, converts as you type, and lets you pretty-print or minify. Options include CSV/TSV headers, auto-typing numbers and booleans, XML escaping and removing nulls. Upload a file, swap formats in one click, and copy or download. Everything runs in your browser. No signup.

records.name: Zaidu
records.tagline: To get good relation with our customers
records.description: high qualitylong lasting and Affordabletested and trusted by many customers glow comfortable with us

records.name: getunspotted
records.tagline: Score your digital privacy, then fix it with free guides
records.description: Most privacy advice is written for power users. GetUnspotted is built for everyone else. Take a brief scored assessment to see where you're exposed, then work through 45 free step-by-step guides, Basic and Advanced, to fix it. New for launch: Unspotted 101, a starter guide for students and young adults. Recommendations rely on independent sources, not vendor claims. We use privacy-respecting analytics, disclose every affiliate link, and recommend tools like Mullvad that pay us nothing.

records.name: QRCard
records.tagline: Digital business cards and vehicle QR tags, no app needed
records.description: QRCard gives you a live digital business card in about two minutes. Share it as a link or QR code and people save you to their phone contacts in one tap, with no app on either side. Update details any time, add links and a booking page, capture leads and see who viewed your card. Also new: Vehicle Smart Tags. Put a QR tag on your car, bike or EV so anyone can call or WhatsApp you about a blocked driveway or emergency. Free to start.

records.name: Redclause.com
records.tagline: Arctic Regulatory - Digital Ticket
records.description: Red Clause is a fictional command system designed for managing festive treaties, elf telemetry, sleigh airspace, and digital nice-list records. It provides a playful take on holiday season bureaucracy, offering features like elf labor telemetry, sleigh clearance, and global gift exchange. This product is ideal for those interested in a whimsical approach to holiday operations and seasonal compliance.

records.name: Pixshop
records.tagline: Turn one selfie into headshots, dating photos, and more
records.description: Most AI headshot tools need 10–20 photos and 30 minutes. Pixshop needs one selfie and under a minute. Get LinkedIn headshots, dating photos, creator content, travel portraits — all from a single phone selfie. Built on Gemini. Free to try, no card.

records.name: INTARC
records.tagline: Weekly profit check for app studios
records.description: See what each app really keeps. Spot ad spend that won’t pay back. Read-only, no SDK.

records.name: After Hours at the Museum
records.tagline: Co-op escape room for your TV, with clues on every phone
records.description: After Hours at the Museum is a co-op escape room you play in a browser, on a laptop hooked up to your TV. Each player joins with their phone and gets clues nobody else has, so you have to talk. 1 to 4 players, same room or remote. First room free, no account.

records.name: Asire
records.tagline: Plan work, talk, meet and track bugs without switching apps
records.description: Asire puts your team’s work in one place. Track tasks on Kanban, calendar and timeline views, chat with your team, and run video meetings with screen share. You can also store shared passwords and keys in vaults and collect bug reports from clients through a simple link, with no account needed. Works on web, iOS, Android and desktop.

records.name: levoleur-de.shop
records.tagline: Levoleur Baby Blue Tracksuit
records.description: Discover Levoleur Baby Blue Tracksuit by Levoleur Germany. Shop modern streetwear with standout designs, comfortable fits and fast Germany shipping.

records.name: Código Morse
records.tagline: Free Spanish Morse code translator with audio
records.description: Código Morse is a free online Morse code translator built for Spanish speakers. Translate text to Morse and back, listen with real audio at adjustable speed (5–40 WPM), and learn with a printable alphabet chart including Ñ and accented vowels. No signup, no install — everything runs in the browser. A traductor Morse español for Mexico, Spain and LatAm.

records.name: EasyTour
records.tagline: Most friendly app for your trips
records.description: Most friendly app for your trips

records.name: Dynamic Robots
records.tagline: Robotics solutions with EU compliance in focus
records.description: Dynamic Robots is a Berlin-based robotics company offering robot sales and software focused on EU legal compliance, with maintenance, technical support, and robotics training through RobozService and RoboterUni.

records.name: PawLogix
records.tagline: AI that reads vet records and tracks pet health
records.description: AI-powered pet care: Decode complex vet records, track health trends, and get personalized proactive insights for your beloved companion. Terms of Use: https://pawlogix.lovable.app/terms

records.name: Cash Calculator
records.tagline: Cash Denomination Calculator for Indian rupee notes
records.description: Free online Cash Calculator and Cash Denomination Calculator for Indian rupee notes. Count ₹500, ₹200, ₹100, then print or download your report.

records.name: Gbyte Transfer
records.tagline: Fast & stable cross-platform data migration
records.description: Switch phones without losing a thing. Gbyte seamlessly moves your photos, messages, and WhatsApp data—cross-platform, wirelessly, and no cables required. No factory reset, no limits.

records.name: Beflaz
records.tagline: daily updates on jobs, scholarships, news, health, dramas
records.description: Subscribe to our newsletter ! Click to read Beflaz, a Substack publication. Launched 22 days ago.

records.name: Bubble Shooter
records.tagline: A bubble shooter with a changing board and no timer
records.description: Play a free browser bubble shooter with no ads, timer or sign-up. Remove a whole colour and the next batch adds more rows. Clear the board and keep your score. Three difficulty modes, saved progress and achievements.

records.name: YesOrNo
records.tagline: Test your next business idea with a shareable yes/no poll
records.description: Turn a business idea into a question worth sharing. Create a yes/no poll, share a link or social card, and see responses and their sources. Free beta includes 100 responses per poll. You bring the audience; votes are signals, not sales.

records.name: Naki search
records.tagline: Fast,safe search engine
records.description: Built in Uganda. Search web, images, videos, news, maps, jobs, live football scores.

records.name: ProfitPilot
records.tagline: Calculate your e-commerce profit, marketplace fees
records.description: Calculate your e-commerce profit, marketplace fees and seller margins with ProfitPilot.

records.name: First Date
records.tagline: The first dating app for actual DATING
records.description: First Date (firstdate.date) is the premier global dating app and web platform for real in-person dates, open to singles worldwide.

records.name: TPV Pro Ultra
records.tagline: Sistema de Punto de Venta sin Suscripciones
records.description: Sistema de punto de venta profesional, offline y sin suscripciones para pequeños negocios.

records.name: deeplinkit
records.tagline: Pass JSON from mobile web to iOS, even after install
records.description: Send users from your website to the right screen in your iOS app, even when they need to install it first. deeplinkit carries your JSON payload through the journey, so invites, referrals, and shared content keep their context. Web, Swift, and React Native SDKs. iOS only to start. Android coming soon. Start free.

records.name: Raindance Maker
records.tagline: Turn two photos into the viral Raindance AI pier video
records.description: Upload two photos and Raindance Maker recasts the viral seaside-pier Raindance AI video: photo 1 becomes the person seated at the start, photo 2 the one who walks in and takes the close-ups. Pick 5, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, a Seedance or MiniMax H3 model and a resolution, see the exact credit cost, then download a 4:3 MP4 with the soundtrack. More trend templates on the same site include Hotel Lobby, Alors on Danse, Smalltown Boy and APT.
